text.p: Following is a summary of major Shanghai political and business stories in local newspapers, preprared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.

- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - China stock markets were in good order in trading on Thursday despite death of Chinese leader Deng Xiaoping. - Turnover on the Shanghai and Shenzhen stock exchanges rose on Thursday with blue-chip indices closing slightly down.
- A total of 1.0752 billion yuan bonds are being issued by the Ministry of Electric Power starting on Friday.
- A total of 1.34 billion yuan bonds from China petrochemical companies will begin issue next Monday.
- World leaders mourn the death of Deng Xiaoping.
- BUSINESS NEWS - Participants at the annual session of the Shanghai People's Congress, the local parliament, pay tribute to Deng Xiaoping.
- Participants at a seminar on Pudong development praise Deng Xiaoping for decision to open the Pudong New Area to the outside world.
- Major Xu Kuandi said Shanghai's economy has hope in long term only if the performance of the state sector is improved.
